verdict.rationale: Warp documents fanning work out across many targets: it can run many agents concurrently across repos or tasks, a coordinated fleet can work a backlog of requests into pull requests, and the Oz CLI makes agent runs scriptable from scripts and CI. There is no evidence of a dedicated bulk-operation feature (select many items, apply one action, review results), so bulk work means orchestrating parallel agents or scripting the CLI yourself. Missing for 10: a native bulk-action capability over many items at once, documentation of batch semantics or progress and rollback for multi-item operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel/fleet execution at scale.
